title: DidSigError: typed error enum
description:
What: Define DidSigError enum in crates/reader/src/post/did_verify.rs (new file, or extend did_passthrough.rs).

Algorithm:
1. Create crates/reader/src/post/did_verify.rs
2. Define: pub enum DidSigError { InvalidFormat(String), UnsupportedMethod(String), InvalidKeyEncoding(String), InvalidSignatureEncoding(String), VerificationFailed, }
3. Implement std::fmt::Display for DidSigError
4. Implement std::error::Error for DidSigError
5. Add pub mod did_verify; to crates/reader/src/post/mod.rs

Defensive programming:
- Each variant carries enough context for a useful log message
- No key material in any variant (signatures and keys are not logged)
- UnsupportedMethod carries the method name (e.g. 'did:web') so operators know what was rejected
